messages.content:
Predict which product was purchased on this purchase occasion.

Use only the supplied facts. Customer motives are unknown.
Do not assume the cheapest product must be purchased.
Support records are unordered separate purchases.
NOT_PROVIDED means unavailable information.
All displayed prices are assumed dollar amounts rounded to two decimals.

CANDIDATES
A = dannon
B = hiland
C = weight
D = yoplait

CURRENT_PRICES
[P_A] A: $9.80
[P_B] B: $6.40
[P_C] C: $7.50
[P_D] D: $10.80

CURRENT_ADVERTISING
[F_A] A: NOT_ADVERTISED
[F_B] B: NOT_ADVERTISED
[F_C] C: NOT_ADVERTISED
[F_D] D: NOT_ADVERTISED

HOUSEHOLD_HISTORY
[H1] Purchased=C; prices={A:$8.10, B:$6.10, C:$7.90, D:$10.80}; advertising={A:NOT_ADVERTISED, B:NOT_ADVERTISED, C:NOT_ADVERTISED, D:NOT_ADVERTISED}.
[H2] Purchased=A; prices={A:$9.80, B:$6.10, C:$8.60, D:$10.80}; advertising={A:NOT_ADVERTISED, B:NOT_ADVERTISED, C:NOT_ADVERTISED, D:NOT_ADVERTISED}.
[H3] Purchased=A; prices={A:$9.80, B:$6.10, C:$8.60, D:$10.80}; advertising={A:NOT_ADVERTISED, B:NOT_ADVERTISED, C:NOT_ADVERTISED, D:NOT_ADVERTISED}.

[H5] Purchased=C; prices={A:$8.60, B:$5.40, C:$7.90, D:$10.80}; advertising={A:NOT_ADVERTISED, B:NOT_ADVERTISED, C:NOT_ADVERTISED, D:NOT_ADVERTISED}.

Give a brief evidence-based explanation, then your final prediction.
Cite the displayed evidence IDs supporting your claims; any number of relevant IDs may be cited.
For relationships or comparisons, cite all necessary evidence.
Distinguish observed patterns from established causal preferences; briefly acknowledge conflicting evidence when relevant.
Do not treat a support purchase as the hidden target purchase.

Return exactly one JSON object, with these keys in this order:
{"explanation":"<brief explanation>","evidence_ids":["<supporting IDs>"],"prediction":"<one valid candidate answer identifier>"}
Prediction must be exactly one of: "A", "B", "C", "D".
